routes.title: Hukill's Inc. | One Call Does It All
routes.description: Plumbing, restoration, excavation, remodels, and foundations — serving Fort Worth, TX and Medford, OR for over 40 years. Available 24/7.

routes.title: All Services | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Browse every service Hukill's offers — plumbing, drain cleaning, septic, excavation, restoration, remodels, foundations, and commercial work. Available 24/7.

routes.title: Plumbing Services | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Full-service plumbing including repairs, replacements, water lines, sewer lines, and trenchless pipe replacement. Emergency plumbing available 24/7.

routes.title: Drain Cleaning | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Professional drain cleaning for every drain — from kitchen sinks to sewer lines. Hydrojetting, snaking, root removal, and camera-verified results. 24/7 service.

routes.title: Leak Detection | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Professional leak detection using acoustic ground microphones, tracer gas, utility locating, and camera video inspection for water and gas lines.

routes.title: Water Heater Service & Installation | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Tank and tankless water heater repair, replacement, and new installation. Honest repair-or-replace guidance and 24/7 emergency water heater service.

routes.title: Septic Services | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Septic tank pumping, system installation, design, and repair for residential and commercial properties. Emergency septic response available 24/7.

routes.title: New Build Plumbing | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Licensed plumbing contractors for new construction. System design, piping, fixtures, water supply, drainage, and gas lines for residential and commercial builds.

routes.title: Commercial Plumbing | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Commercial plumbing for excavation, sewer mains, water lines, underground utilities, and emergency failures. Built for property managers and contractors.

routes.title: Excavation Services | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Full excavation including trench digging, asphalt cutting, septic site prep, water and sewer line replacement, and complete project coordination.

routes.title: Restoration Services | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: 24/7 water, fire, and storm damage restoration — extraction, drying, demolition, reconstruction, and deodorizing for homes and businesses.

routes.title: Remodeling Services | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Kitchen and bath remodels, interior and exterior painting, custom cabinet design and install, and flooring installation. Serving Fort Worth and Medford.

routes.title: Foundation Repair | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Foundation repair using push piers and helical piers, crawl space encapsulation, and basement waterproofing. Protect your home from settling and water damage.

routes.title: Our Projects | Hukill's Inc.
routes.description: Browse Hukill's portfolio of completed foundation, restoration, remodel, plumbing, and excavation projects across Fort Worth, TX and Medford, OR.
